title: agrostis heterolepis
intro: Agrostis heterolepis, commonly known as Indian grass, is a type of grass native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the relief of symptoms associated with respiratory issues and improved digestion. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis heterolepis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
